name: Claude Code Prompts
description: The prompts you typed into Claude Code, drawn from your local command history, each with its timestamp, the project it was issued in, and the session it belonged to. Pasted attachment bodies are excluded; only a flag indicating their presence is kept.

profile.description: Identifying account context for the Claude Code installation (read locally; never includes credentials).

display.description: The prompt text as typed (including slash commands like '/clear').

project.description: Absolute path of the working directory the prompt was issued in.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the session the prompt belonged to.

hasPastedContent.description: Whether the prompt carried pasted attachment content (the content itself is not exported).

profile.description: Identifying account context for the Claude Code installation (read locally; never includes credentials).

numStartups.description: Number of times Claude Code has been launched on this machine.

firstStartTime.description: First launch timestamp on this machine (ISO 8601).
